title: PEEBLES_PLUS_CORRECTED_OPTICAL_DEPTH_APPEAL
recombination_model: Peebles (1968) effective-three-level atom; H-only; Boltzmann factor exp(-13.6 eV / kT) in beta_eff (Bug A corrected in precommit text and runner)
drag_epoch_model: baryon-drag optical depth integral; integrand 1/(a * H * R_b) (Bug B corrected)
optical_depth_operator: Thomson optical depth integrand 1/(a * H) (Bug B corrected)
bbn_model: schematic Wagoner two-state freeze-out; reported only, not gated

corrections_from_CR001b_at_19.Bug_A_fix: Peebles beta_eff uses exp(-13.6 eV / kT) instead of exp(-3.4 eV / kT). Drives equilibrium to Saha-13.6 (standard hydrogen recombination); the precommit-specified exp(-3.4 eV/kT) form drives to Saha-n=2 which sits at x_e ~ 1 forever.
corrections_from_CR001b_at_19.Bug_B_fix: Optical-depth integrand is 1/(a * H) per the standard derivation tau = integral(n_e sigma_T c dt') with dt = da/(a*H). The CR001@19 and CR001b@19 precommits had 1/(a^2 * H), which over-counts by 1/a at small a and pushes tau=1 to too-late times.

P1.name: Acoustic angular scale 100*theta_* within 5% of Planck

P2.name: Acoustic peak multipole ell_A within 5% of Planck

P3.name: Drag sound horizon r_d within 5% of Planck

reported_evidence_not_gates.E2: z_* DERIVED via Peebles + Thomson tau = 1073.06 vs Planck 1089.92 (-1.55%)
reported_evidence_not_gates.E3: z_d DERIVED via baryon-drag tau = 1055.81 vs Planck 1059.94 (-0.39%)
reported_evidence_not_gates.E7-E12: schematic BBN (eta_10 +4.47%, Y_p schematic +60.73%, D/H -6.76%); independent of recombination physics

verdict_reason: P1, P2, P3 all hold under canonical substrate inputs with corrected Peebles RHS (Boltzmann factor 13.6 eV) and corrected Thomson/drag tau integrand (1/(a*H)). Substrate identities reproduce Planck CMB acoustic geometry within 2% with derived recombination physics and zero catalog fits.
